description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dewarammulla, Pallepola D/S Division, Matale District - Cad. Map No.310008 (24/0145)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels, their ownership details, extents, and encumbrances. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category. The document is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette, further confirming its classification as a land-related matter rather than government personnel or organizational changes.
